How did the total vote in U.S. House general elections change from 2014 to 2018?
SELECT year, sum(try_cast(candidatevotes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_house_returns WHERE stage = 'GEN' AND year IN ('2014', '2018') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which New York load zones used the most power on average in 2023?

SELECT name, avg(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS average_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average three-bedroom fair market rent across Florida's counties?
SELECT avg(try_cast(fmr3 AS double)) AS avg_three_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE state_alpha = 'FL'
Which New York nuclear plants have filed the most event reports?
SELECT facility, count(*) AS events FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_event_notifications WHERE state = 'NY' AND category = 'Power Reactor' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many utility rate schedules come with net metering rules?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE dgrules = 'Net Metering'
Which categories of federal award are most numerous: contracts, grants, loans or direct payments?
SELECT category, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the longest patent term adjustment the USPTO has granted?
SELECT max(try_cast(patent_term_adjustment AS double)) AS most_days FROM govblock_patents.patex_pta_summary_25
Which dosage forms are most common among approved drug products?
SELECT dosage_form, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE dosage_form IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the presidential vote cast in Florida change from 1976 to 2020?
SELECT year, max(try_cast(totalvotes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_president_returns WHERE state_po = 'FL' AND year IN ('1976', '2020') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which chemical systems have the most computed materials?
SELECT chemsys, count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many GAO reports have cybersecurity in the title?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND lower(title) LIKE '%cybersecurity%'
Which power plants have the most generating capacity in all?

SELECT plant_name, state, round(sum(mw)) AS capacity_mw FROM (SELECT plant_code, plant_name, state, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
Which Labor Department rules about overtime have appeared on the regulatory agenda?
SELECT DISTINCT rin, rule_title FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE acronym LIKE '%DOL%' AND lower(rule_title) LIKE '%overtime%' LIMIT 10
At which hours of the day does Texas solar output peak, on average?
Ercot Hourly Solar Report Cdr Pvgrhrlyavgactnp
SELECT hour_ending, round(avg(try_cast(system_wide_gen AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.ercot_hourly_solar_report_cdr_pvgrhrlyavgactnp GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many citation links between opinions does the archive map?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.citation_map
Which states file the most Do Not Call complaints?
SELECT consumer_state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.ftc_dnc_complaints WHERE consumer_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many counties does the block crosswalk cover in Georgia?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cty) AS n FROM govblock_labor.lodes_xwalk WHERE stusps = 'GA'
Which fuels power the most units in EPA's Clean Air Markets programs in 2023?
SELECT primary_fuel_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND primary_fuel_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is aspirin's CAS registry number?
SELECT c1 AS cas_number FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_identifiers WHERE c0 = '2244' AND c2 = 'CAS'
Which states have the most judicial positions on record?
SELECT location_state, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE position_type = 'jud' AND coalesce(location_state, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of closed Texas rate filings were withdrawn by the insurer?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN closed_type = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_property_casualty_rate_filings WHERE status = 'Closed'
Which technology fields saw the most patents granted in 2023?

SELECT first_wipo_field_title AS field, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_annual WHERE cast(assignee_sequence AS varchar) = '0' AND cast(grant_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average energy of the aspirin frames in revised MD17?
SELECT avg(energy_kcal_mol) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.rmd17_frames WHERE molecule = 'aspirin'
Which categories of drinking water violation are most common?

SELECT CASE violation_category_code WHEN 'MCL' THEN 'Maximum contaminant level' WHEN 'MR' THEN 'Monitoring and reporting' WHEN 'MON' THEN 'Monitoring' WHEN 'RPT' THEN 'Reporting' WHEN 'TT' THEN 'Treatment technique' WHEN 'MRDL' THEN 'Maximum residual disinfectant level' ELSE violation_category_code END AS category, count(DISTINCT violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many compounds were confirmed active against HIV in the screening set?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_hiv WHERE activity = 'CA'
Which databases contribute the most compound records to UniChem?

SELECT s.name_long, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_chemistry.unichem_reference AS r JOIN govblock_chemistry.unichem_source AS s ON cast(s.src_id AS varchar) = cast(r.src_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much natural gas was in Lower 48 underground storage in the week ending November 1, 2024?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_cubic_feet FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.NW2_EPG0_SWO_R48_BCF.W' AND period = '20241101'
Which utilities have the most rate schedules in the Utility Rate Database?
SELECT utility, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.utility_rate_database WHERE utility IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was New York's highest hourly electricity demand in 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(demand_mw AS double)) AS peak_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2022'
Apart from the United States, which countries do federally bought goods and services come from most?

SELECT country_of_product_or_service_origin, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND country_of_product_or_service_origin_code <> 'USA' AND country_of_product_or_service_origin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many NSF awards took effect each year from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT substr(awardeffectivedate, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS awards FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards WHERE substr(awardeffectivedate, 7, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which arXiv subjects saw the most papers revised four or more times?
SELECT primary_category, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE try_cast(substr(latest_version, 2) AS integer) >= 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much carbon dioxide did power plants in New York emit in 2021?
SELECT sum(co2_mass_short_tons) AS co2_short_tons FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE state = 'NY' AND year(date) = 2021
Which companies hold the most cellular licences?
SELECT column07 AS licensee, count(DISTINCT column04) AS call_signs FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_uls_l_en WHERE uls_file = 'l_cell.zip' AND column05 = 'L' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many protein complexes are listed as drug targets in ChEMBL?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_target_dictionary WHERE target_type = 'PROTEIN COMPLEX'
